preface.p: Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2021
An Act to amend the law relating to sport, and for related purposes
Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection Act 2014 3
An Act to amend the law relating to sport, and for related purposes

content.p: This Act is the Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Act 2021.

Each provision of this Act specified in column 1 of the table commences, or is taken to have commenced, in accordance with column 2 of the table. Any other statement in column 2 has effect according to its terms.

tr.td: The day after this Act receives the Royal Assent.

content.p: Note: This table relates only to the provisions of this Act as originally enacted. It will not be amended to deal with any later amendments of this Act.
Any information in column 3 of the table is not part of this Act. Information may be inserted in this column, or information in it may be edited, in any published version of this Act.

Legislation that is specified in a Schedule to this Act is amended or repealed as set out in the applicable items in the Schedule concerned, and any other item in a Schedule to this Act has effect according to its terms.

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: Main amendments

hcontainer.name: amendedAct
hcontainer.heading: Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection Act 2014

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Section 9

content.p: Before “In this Act”, insert “(1)”.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Section 9 (definition of event body)

content.p: After “specified as an event body in”, insert “, or a body prescribed by rules made for the purposes of,”.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Section 9 (at the end of the definition of event body)

content.p: Add:
Note: See also subsection (2).

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: At the end of section 9

content.p: Add:
(2) For the purposes of the definition of event body in subsection (1), the rules may prescribe a body for the purposes of a Schedule to this Act that covers a major sporting event only if:
the authorising body for the event requests the Minister in writing to make those rules; and
the Minister is satisfied that:
there was a delay in the establishment of the body that prevented the body from being specified by name in that Schedule; or
there has been a change of name of an existing event body for the event.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Schedule 1

content.p: Repeal the Schedule, substitute:

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: Note: See section 9.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022 is a major sporting event

content.p: The event known as the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022 is a major sporting event covered by this Schedule.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Authorising body for ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: ICC Business Corporation FZ-LLC (being a wholly-owned subsidiary of International Cricket Council Limited) is the authorising body for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Event bodies for ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: The following are event bodies for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022:
the authorising body;
International Cricket Council Limited;
T20 World Cup 2020 Ltd (ACN 618 113 269);
Cricket Australia (ACN 006 089 130);
a body that is prescribed by the rules.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Protected indicia of ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: The following are protected indicia of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022:
ICC T20 World Cup 2022;
ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022;
T20 World Cup;
T20WC;
International Cricket Council;
any expression that is prescribed by the rules;
any expression that, to a reasonable person, would suggest a connection with the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022;
whether or not used in combination with any other expressions, letters, numbers or symbols.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: When protected indicia and images relate to an event body for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: Protected indicia and images of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022 relate to each event body for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022, except as prescribed by the rules.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Protection period for ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022

content.p: The protection period for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022 is the period:
starting at the commencement of this clause; and
ending at the end of:
13 November 2023, unless subparagraph (ii) applies; or
if the rules prescribe an earlier day for the purposes of this subparagraph—that earlier day.

hcontainer.name: item
hcontainer.heading: Schedule 3

content.p: Repeal the Schedule, substitute:

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: Note: See section 9.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023 is a major sporting event

content.p: The event known as the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023 is a major sporting event covered by this Schedule.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Authorising body for Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: The Fédération Internationale de Football Association is the authorising body for the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Event bodies for Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: The following are event bodies for the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023:
the authorising body;
Football Australia Limited (ACN 106 478 068);
FWWC2023 Pty Ltd (ACN 650 853 302);
a body that is prescribed by the rules.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Protected indicia of Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: The following are protected indicia of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023:
FIFA Women’s World Cup;
FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023;
FIFA Women’s World Cup Australia 2023;
FIFA Women’s World Cup New Zealand 2023;
FIFA Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023;
FWWC2023;
Fédération Internationale de Football Association;
any expression that is prescribed by the rules;
any expression that, to a reasonable person, would suggest a connection with the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023;
whether or not used in combination with any other expressions, letters, numbers or symbols.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: When protected indicia and images relate to an event body for the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: Protected indicia and images of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023 relate to each event body for the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023, except as prescribed by the rules.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Protection period for Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023

content.p: The protection period for the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) Women’s World Cup Australia New Zealand 2023 is the period:
starting at the commencement of this clause; and
ending at the end of:
31 December 2024, unless subparagraph (ii) applies; or
if the rules prescribe an earlier day for the purposes of this subparagraph—that earlier day.

hcontainer.name: clause
hcontainer.heading: Transitional provision—ICC T20 World Cup 2020

content.p: Despite the repeal of Schedule 1 to the Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection Act 2014 made by this Schedule, that Schedule, as in force immediately before the commencement of this item, continues to apply on and after that commencement in relation to the ICC T20 World Cup 2020.
